name: bx-sites
description: Use bx-sites skills for content authoring, site configuration/theming/publishing, and CI workflow execution/debugging in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Create, publish, and troubleshoot bx-sites sites and workflows.
interface.longDescription: Provides bx-sites skills for creating and authoring site content with advanced Markdown/content-block options, configuring/theming/extending/deploying a bx-sites site, and operating the ortus-boxlang/bx-sites repository's own GitHub Actions workflows (test, snapshot, release, docs, pages pipelines).
defaultPrompt: Scaffold a new bx-sites project with the material theme and a getting-started page.
Add a card grid and a stepper walkthrough to docs/getting-started.md.
Set up a deployments/production.json target for S3 and deploy the site.
Check the latest bx-sites Test Suites workflow failure and summarize root cause.
